records.part: Hybrid Drivetrain as well as glass for the 2019 New Flyer Artic fleet
records.reason: This project consists of purchases of new and rebuilt parts. Major Bus Components with unit prices of $5,000 or more are included in the Capital Budgets.

records.part: Purchase of 14 Gasoline Low Floor Paratransit Minivans
records.reason: The District will replace fourteen 2020 Paratransit Braun Gasoline Minivans, which have a replacement life cycle of 5 years and will reach end-of-life in 2025.

records.part: Purchase of 29 Hydrogen Fuel Cell Electric Buses
records.reason: There District has 29 model year 2013 Gillig buses (25 Gillig Hybrid 40' buses and 4 Gillig Diesel 29' buses) that will reach end-of-life in 2025.

records.part: Replacement Non-Rev Svc Support Vehicles - nine non-revenue District vehicles: three sport utility vehicles and six hybrid/electric models
records.reason: This project consists of purchasing nine non-revenue District vehicles: three sport utility vehicles and six hybrid/electric models.

records.part: Rehab North Base and South Base Steam Bay Equipment - hydraulic pumps, cylinders, high-pressure hoses, metal bi-fold doors
records.reason: Components of the lift equipment, including hydraulic pumps, cylinders, and high-pressure hoses, have exceeded their useful lives due to their heavy usage and constant exposure to high pressure/temperature steam.

records.part: Facilities Smaller Projects - repairs/replacements of water heaters, fire suppression equipment, sewer pumps, circuit breakers, roll-up doors at bases, rain gutters
records.reason: Work is anticipated to include common repairs and replacements of water heaters, fire suppression equipment, sewer pumps, circuit breakers, roll-up doors at bases, rain gutters, etc.

records.part: North Base and South Base Hardening - vandal and climb resistant perimeter fencing, turnstile entry gates, vehicular gate arms
records.reason: This project will install new vandal and climb resistant perimeter fencing at North and South Bases over the next 3 to 4 years depending on funding availability. It will also install turnstile entry gates for pedestrians and control vehicular gate arms at entries into North and South Bases.

records.part: Bus Shelter Assets - payment for remaining useful life value of existing bus shelters
records.reason: This project will allow the District to pay the vendor for the remaining useful life value of existing bus shelters.
